en.headline: SSSDP to fund 4,711 places next year, with fewer therapy seats
en.dek: The Education Bureau will subsidise 70 fewer undergraduate places in 2027/28, including cuts of 20 first-year seats each in physiotherapy and occupational therapy.
body: The Education Bureau said on Monday that the Study Subsidy Scheme for Designated Professions/Sectors will support 4,711 undergraduate places across 59 programmes at eight self-financing institutions in the 2027/28 academic year, 70 fewer than in the current year.

The intake covers 3,390 first-year-first-degree places and 1,321 top-up degree places. Applied degree programmes under the scheme will rise from 16 to 20 and will receive additional subsidies. Annual subsidies will be HK$81,450 for laboratory-based programmes and HK$46,780 for others. The designated fields remain the same 10 disciplines identified as having keen manpower demand, including healthcare, architecture and engineering, computer science and tourism and hospitality.

Among the larger reductions, first-year physiotherapy places at Saint Francis University and first-year occupational therapy places at Tung Wah College will each fall from 60 to 40. The Hong Kong Metropolitan University remains the largest recipient of subsidised places among the participating institutions. Two newly included programmes are an applied science degree in robotics and automation engineering at HKMU and a digital entertainment programme at Hong Kong Shue Yan University.

The Bureau said programme lists and place numbers were set after consultation with relevant bureaux and departments. Local reporting cited a tighter job market for new physiotherapy graduates as context for the healthcare cuts; a physiotherapy association was quoted as supporting a reduction to avoid adding to unemployment in the sector.

zh.headline: 指定專業資助計劃下學年4711個學額 治療課程減少
zh.dek: 教育局公布2027/28學年SSSDP學額較本學年少70個，聖方濟各大學物理治療及東華學院校職業治療一年級各減20個。
body: 教育局周一公布，「指定專業／界別課程資助計劃」於2027/28學年將資助8間自資專上院校合共59個學士學位課程、4711個學額，較本學年少70個。
當中包括3390個第一年學士學位學額及1321個衔接學位學額。計劃下的應用學位課程由16個增至20個，並獲額外資助。實驗為本課程每年資助額為81,450元，非實驗為本課程為46,780元。課程繼續涵蓋10個人力需求較殳切的界別，包括醫療、建築及工程、電腦科學，以及旅遊及款待等。
學額減幅較大的課程包括聖方濟各大學物理治療學（榮譽）理學士一年級，以及東華學院職業治療學（榮譽）理學士一年級，均由60個減至40個。都會大學在資助課程數目及學額方面繼續居自資院校之首。新納入計劃的課程包括都大機械人及自動化工程應用理學士，以及樹仁大學娛樂及遊戲應用數碼方案課程。
教育局表示，資助課程及學額數目是在諮詢相關政策局及部門後醮定。本地報道指物理治療畢業生就業轉趨緊紐，有物理治療業界團體支持適度減少學額，以免加劇失業。
